column3: The doorbell: the one always-on part of 4x4's P2P. It holds the endpoint and the device list on one thread, and starts a tool when another device knocks for it (services/p2p/README.md › The doorbell and its tools)
The 4x4 engine: pairs with the person's 4x4 desk and runs their own agents (Claude Code, Codex, ACP agents) as a background service
The 4x4 home server: one front door per computer, by name, for every device in the house.
Who someone is, for 4x4: one ed25519 key per device, the identity line x4-p2p hands the engine, relay passes.
x4-p2p's basics: the device store, circles and people, joining, passes, the log line; what every other part of x4-p2p stands on
x4-p2p's files by hash between a person's devices (iroh-blobs)
x4-p2p's shared notes: typing together on loro, saved as versions
x4-p2p's talks: one kept conversation per group of devices, its lines and who has read them
Runs every P2P test on this computer and writes one PASS or FAIL file (_talk/p2p-test)
x4-p2p's versions of a person's folders and notes, between their own devices (gix through x4-versions)
Every fact this computer holds about every Claude session, one row per session: the home server's sessions reader.
